description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI class, a REST API controller for handling operations related to employee timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and managing timesheet entries, along with validation rules, and utilizes various traits and models for processing timesheet data.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for managing employee timesheet entries, extending Endpoint and implementing CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves detailed timesheet entries along with metadata, including allowed actions and employee details.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches a timesheet by ID and checks user permissions.

methods.name: getResultMetaForGetAll
methods.description: Assembles metadata information for the getAll response, like dates, totals, columns, employee info, and allowed actions.

methods.name: getNormalizedEmployee
methods.description: Normalizes Employee entity data into an array suitable for API output.

methods.name: getNormalizedTimesheet
methods.description: Normalizes Timesheet entity data into an array for API output.

methods.name: getNormalizedTotalDuration
methods.description: Converts total duration in minutes into a normalized array including hours and minutes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rule for fetching all timesheet entries.

methods.name: getTimesheetIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for timesheet ID parameter.
